question: Which additional ritual elements are also shared with the ten-syllabled mantra model?
premises: The analogy with the ten-syllabled mantra continues.
Attributes such as metre, seer, and deity are included.
Application and nyāsa are also included.
inference: The metre, seer, deity, and related elements, as well as application and nyāsa, are also to be taken as in the ten-syllabled mantra.
uncertainties: The exact scope of ādi in ekacchandarṣidevādi is not specified.
plain_english: The metre, seer, deity, and so forth, as well as application and nyāsa, are also the same as for the ten-syllabled mantra.
